- name: Check for a matching entry
  ansible.builtin.shell: printf '%s\n' example | grep example
  ignore_errors: "{{ ansible_check_mode }}"
  changed_when: false

---
- name: Check for a matching entry
  ansible.builtin.shell: printf '%s\n' example | grep example
  ignore_errors: true
